A0031373P.name: 3MGB Wilderness Radio
A0031373P.description: Community radio for Mallacoota, Genoa and surrounding Far East Gippsland, run by volunteers. On air as 3MGB — Mallacoota 101.7 FM and Genoa 96.9 FM. The legal entity is Mallacoota Genoa Broadcasting Association Inc.
A0031373P.descriptionShort: Volunteer community radio for Mallacoota and Genoa.

A0110781S.name: Mallacoota and District Recovery Association
A0110781S.description: MADRA was established after the 2019–20 bushfires so the needs of Mallacoota and district are considered as part of recovery. It is an incorporated association and a registered charity. Legal name: Mallacoota And District Recovery Association Incorporated.
A0110781S.descriptionShort: Community-led recovery association for Mallacoota and district.
A0110781S.serviceArea: Mallacoota, Genoa, Gipsy Point, Wangarabell, Weeragua, Maramingo Creek, Wallagaraugh and Wroxham

A0020481Z.name: Mallacoota Arts Council
A0020481Z.description: Hosts, presents and produces professional and community arts activities in and around Mallacoota, including Mallacoota Arts Space (MA Space) at the Croajingolong Centre.
A0020481Z.descriptionShort: Community arts council and MA Space gallery.

A0012127E.name: Mallacoota District Health and Support Service
A0012127E.description: Community health, in-home aged and disability support, allied health clinics and the Mallacoota District Health Neighbourhood House. Not a hospital emergency department — in an emergency call 000.
A0012127E.descriptionShort: Community health, aged and disability support, and neighbourhood house.

address.street: Corner Mattsson Street and Genoa Road

A0012127E.accessibility: Accessible toilet, accessible parking and wheelchair access, according to Healthdirect.

A0004620V.name: Mallacoota Golf and Country Club
A0004620V.description: The golf club itself — the sporting organisation. Meals and drinks are listed separately as Mallacoota Golf Club Bistro under Eat & Drink.
A0004620V.descriptionShort: Golf club. Bistro listed separately under Eat & Drink.

A0042120A.name: Mallacoota Surf Lifesaving Club
A0042120A.description: Volunteer surf lifesaving club patrolling Mallacoota’s ocean beaches. Public contact published by the club is the email and Instagram below; patrol times vary with the season.
A0042120A.descriptionShort: Volunteer surf lifesaving club for Mallacoota’s ocean beaches.

A0095823N.name: Mallacoota Community Health, Infrastructure and Resilience Fund
A0095823N.description: A health promotion charity and fundraising body, not a clinic or hospital. Do not contact CHIRF for medical care — see Mallacoota Medical Centre or Mallacoota District Health and Support Service.
A0095823N.descriptionShort: Health infrastructure fundraising body. Not a clinic.

A0108792I.name: Mallacoota Volunteer Fire Fighters Fund
A0108792I.description: A fundraising body supporting volunteer firefighters. This is not the CFA brigade and must not be used for fire reports or emergency contact. For fire and warnings use VicEmergency; in an emergency call 000.
A0108792I.descriptionShort: Fundraising body, not the CFA brigade.

A0124949R.name: Mallacoota Marine Search and Rescue
A0124949R.description: Volunteer marine search and rescue association. In a life-threatening emergency call 000. The earlier Mallacoota Coast Guard Inc. is deregistered; do not treat that name as current.
A0124949R.descriptionShort: Volunteer marine search and rescue. In an emergency call 000.
